traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Table 5 (page 12) provides per-category totals for 6 ISO 16140-2 categories (Composite; Meat products; Dairy products; Fruits and vegetables; Seafood; Environmental samples), each of which is further subdivided into sub-types (a/b/c) in the source table - those sub-type rows were not recorded as separate categories per instructions, only the category 'Total' rows were used. 'All categories', 'General protocol', and 'Specific protocol' rows are aggregate/summary rows and were excluded. This report is a qualitative (detection) method for Listeria spp, so no quantitative relative-trueness/bias table or Acceptability Limit (log) applies; the Acceptability Limit discussed in the report (RLOD AL = 2.5, and inter-lab AL=4.77) pertains to RLOD/inter-lab calculations, not a quantitative bias study, so quantitative fields were left null.
